name: Easy Creamy Coleslaw Recipe
description: This easy coleslaw recipe is the perfect summer side dish! The creamy homemade dressing fills it with sweet and tangy flavor. I like to shred the cabbage and carrots myself, but feel free to use a store-bought bag of slaw mix if you prefer.
author: Jeanine Donofrio, Phoebe Moore
ingredients: 2 medium carrots (julienned or shredded on the large holes of a box grater)
instructions: Make the coleslaw dressing. In a medium bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, mustard, sugar, celery seeds, salt, and several grinds of pepper.
Make the coleslaw. In a large bowl, toss together the green and red cabbage, carrots, and onion. Pour the dressing over the top and toss to coat. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving to allow the cabbage to soften and the flavors to meld.
